purpose: Frozen second-image scoring reference; NEVER supplied to Agent, production service or recognition tools
annotationMethod: Independent visual reading of the original raster before the V3-5 second-image batch; no Agent draft copied
limits: Raster positions approximate. The top overall 9700 mm dimension is the sole scale anchor. Three south bay projections are normalized to standard window openings; fixed entry cabinets are excluded from target furniture under the approved open-kitchen/entry rule; and the unenclosed white north strip is not invented as a room.
dimensionPolicy: Measure the solved feature distance, not reference-pixel length times candidate scale. Raster localization thresholds remain unchanged.
